name: Ayaya Enishi
source:
Role: Troublemaker

Talk about a friendly, cheerful, noisy, and large breasts, that would be Ayaya. She seems to hope for something romantic from [url=/c1435]Akihito[/url], her senpai. She also respects her other senpai, [url=/c1436]Kagome[/url] due to dubious reasons.
